Our philosophy

Skin wellness, reimagined.

Why Radiantè exists — and the belief that shapes everything we make.

A ritual, not a repair job.

Radiantè began with a quiet frustration: a shelf full of products that promised to correct, erase, and fix — and a culture that treats skin like a problem to be solved. We wanted the opposite. One considered object. Ten unhurried minutes. A pause that feels like care rather than correction.

So we made the mask we wanted for ourselves — wireless, weightless, and beautiful enough to leave in plain sight. Worn each evening, it becomes less a gadget and more a signal to yourself: that you're worth the time, and that looking radiant starts with taking care.

"Your skin isn't a flaw to erase. It's yours to look after."

The science

Beauty, backed by light.

The emotion comes first — but the technology is real. Radiantè uses cleared LED wavelengths, presented plainly so you know exactly what you're bringing home.

01
Red
Warm red light is the range most widely studied in at-home light care, and the one most associated with a smoother, firmer-looking appearance over consistent use. It's the everyday glow most people reach for night after night.
02
Blue & Orange
Cool blue light is the clarifying setting, favored when skin looks congested or breakout-prone. Warm orange light is the radiance boost — a brighter, more even-looking tone and an instant lit-from-within glow for dull, tired skin.
03
Four light modes
Red (the everyday glow), Blue (the clarifying setting), Orange (the radiance boost), and Purple (red and blue blended for the full ritual) — the four settings on the device, selected from the magnetic remote.
04
Silicone form factor
The LEDs are embedded in soft, flexible medical-grade silicone rather than rigid plastic, so the light sits close and even across the contours of the face — comfortable enough to wear hands-free for the full session.
510(k) 510(k) FDA ClearanceCleared light-based LED technology.

How it works

How it fits into your life.

Wireless and weightless, worn ten quiet minutes a night. Three simple steps — the whole secret is consistency.

01
Cleanse

Start with clean, dry skin. Remove makeup and skincare so the light reaches your skin evenly.

02
Choose & wear

Snap on the magnetic remote, pick your mode, and settle in. Read, stretch, or simply close your eyes for ten minutes.

03
Nourish

Follow with your serum or moisturiser and let the ritual close your day. Consistency is the whole secret.

A note on rhythm

Use once daily for no more than 15 minutes per session. There's no benefit to overdoing it — a consistent ten-minute ritual is exactly what the mask is designed for. Full guidance is in the product disclaimer.

Ten minutes a night. Your way.

Product disclaimer

Please read before use.

Last updated: May 2026
Please read this disclaimer carefully before purchasing or using the Radiantè LED Light Therapy Mask. By purchasing or using this product, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to the terms below.

Not medical advice

The Radiantè LED Light Therapy Mask is a cosmetic wellness device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. All information on this website is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice.

Who should not use this product

This product is not suitable for individuals who:

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have been diagnosed with epilepsy or are prone to photosensitive seizures
  • Have active skin cancer or a history of skin cancer on the face
  • Are taking photosensitizing medications (certain antibiotics, retinoids, or acne medications)
  • Have active skin infections, open wounds, or severe inflammatory conditions in the treatment area
  • Have implanted electronic devices such as pacemakers or neurostimulators
  • Are under 18 without parental supervision and medical guidance
⚠ Eye safety warning

This device emits bright LED light. Do not stare directly into the LEDs. Individuals with heightened light sensitivity or eye conditions should consult an ophthalmologist before use. Keep out of reach of children under 18.

Individual results may vary

Results vary between individuals based on skin type, frequency of use, age, lifestyle, and other personal factors. Any testimonials on this website reflect individual experiences and are not guarantees of results.

Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Radiantè and its owners, operators, employees, suppliers, and affiliates shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising out of or relating to:

  • Your use or misuse of this product
  • Failure to follow the provided usage instructions or safety guidelines
  • Any allergic reaction, skin sensitivity, or adverse response to LED light therapy
  • Any medical condition that arises or worsens in connection with use of this device
  • Any reliance on information presented on this website

Safe usage instructions

  • Do not exceed 15 minutes per session. Limit use to one session per day
  • Allow skin to rest at least 24 hours between sessions if irritation occurs
  • Do not use on broken, sunburned, or severely irritated skin
  • Discontinue use immediately and consult a doctor if you experience pain, burning, or swelling
  • Keep the device clean, dry, and stored away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures

Governing law

This disclaimer and any disputes arising from it shall be governed by the laws of the State of New Jersey, United States. Any legal action must be filed in the appropriate courts located within New Jersey.
